_meta.purpose: Demo safety net for Scene 2.5. Used only if Track A's find-contradictions skill (A.6) produces mush at hour 8. Both takes hand-verified from corpus reading on 2026-05-16.
_meta.soft_contradiction_note: C.5.5 spec disprefers 'obvious updates to better information' as contradictions. This pair is the strongest hand-verifiable PG flip in the corpus — growth.md frames growth as 'the ONLY essential thing,' aord.md frames runway awareness as also essential. PG himself never frames it as a flip, but the emphasis shift is substantive (priority of growth-rate vs default-alive). If A.6 finds a harder contradiction, prefer that over this.

claim_a.text: A startup is a company designed to grow fast. The only essential thing is growth. Everything else we associate with startups follows from growth.

claim_b.text: When I talk to a startup that's been operating for more than 8 or 9 months, the first thing I want to know is almost always the same: by default do they live or die? Half the founders I talk to don't know whether they're default alive or default dead.

contradiction_summary: In 2012 he argued growth was the only essential thing and the compass for every decision; in 2015 he conceded that without explicit runway awareness, growth alone can ride you off a cliff.
